children: American Outdoor Brands, Inc. reported results for the current quarter of 2026 with revenue rising to $37.25M and a reduced net loss of ($1.53M) versus ($6.83M) a year earlier; diluted loss per share improved to ($0.12) from ($0.54).
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per share”.
Revenue growth of 25.4% was driven by timing of traditional-channel orders and pricing actions; traditional channels increased 28.4% while e‑commerce rose 20.1%.
Sales to two large retailers and DTC gains contributed to channel momentum.
New products introduced within the past 24 months made up 36.1% of sales, supporting a higher-margin mix and improved gross margin.
The company received $14.2M of IEEPA tariff refunds (with $1.7M remaining receivable), bolstering operating cash flow and working capital.
Management completed a planned inventory build of $8.4M to support fall/winter hunting, holiday launches and upcoming product rollouts.
